purpose: Auditable machine-readable record of the data available for the C(n+1) inhomogeneous-triviality question.

algebra.name: C(n+1)
algebra.structure_constant_status: Not specified as a complete normalized table in the supplied definitions; do not infer or fabricate coefficients.

gb_parameters.definition: gb[sigma,j,s], with sigma in {+,-}, j in 1..n, s in {+,-}

parity_check.comment: An odd coefficient times odd kappa has even parity, unlike the stated bracket. Clarify parameter parity or the relation.

gamma.coefficient_map_status: The definitions say coefficients are derived from oscillator relations but give no formulas mapping gb parameters to cochain coefficients.
gamma.coefficient_module_identification: Ambiguous: the deformation term is described in kappa*g and gamma is also called g-valued, without a specified identification and parity convention.
gamma.cocycle_constraint_status: No explicit parameter constraints or coefficient-level cocycle/Jacobi equations supplied.

coboundary.basis_coefficient_formula: D(phi)[i,j,k]=(-1)^p_i sum_r phi[r,j] c[i,r,k]-(-1)^((p_i+1)p_j) sum_r phi[r,i] c[j,r,k]-sum_l c[i,j,l] phi[k,l]
coboundary.triviality_equation: Gamma(gb)[i,j,k] = D(phi)[i,j,k] for every basis triple i,j,k, with phi[r,j]=0 unless p_r=p_j+1 mod 2.

up_to_scalar_interpretation.recommended_test: Exact equality in C^2(g,g), after specifying the coefficient-module identification.
up_to_scalar_interpretation.single_global_nonzero_scalar: Equivalent to exact coboundarity because delta is linear and the scalar can be absorbed into f.
up_to_scalar_interpretation.independent_scalar_per_pair_or_coefficie: Not a well-defined cohomological equivalence; do not apply.

finding.definitive_statement: No necessary-and-sufficient condition on gb, and no conclusion about nonzero trivial configurations, is determined until the structure constants and the map gb -> Gamma(gb) are specified.
finding.conditional_criterion: Once supplied, gb is trivial exactly when Gamma(gb) lies in the image of the coboundary matrix D on odd 1-cochains.

required_additional_inputs: Complete homogeneous basis and normalized structure constants for each requested n.
Complete oscillator/pre-oscillator relations and explicit formulas for every gamma coefficient as a function of gb.
Consistent parity convention and identification of kappa*g with the adjoint coefficient module.
Explicit super-skew-symmetry and 2-cocycle/Jacobi constraints on admissible gb.
